audit.whatIsWrong: Five chart rows contradicted their own prose: whys[1] describes a Gragas trade win at 2, whys[2] says 'It's even at 3', whys[3] and whys[4] are Gragas windows, whys[5] says 'it's a coinflip' — yet the chart read Gwen, Gwen, Skill, Skill, Gwen.
audit.why: Packet levelChart reads Skill, Gragas, Skill, Gragas, Gragas, Skill, Gwen, and the gwen__gragas mirror audit corrected to exactly that sequence.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-5 flipped in both layers to Gragas, Skill, Gragas, Gragas, Skill with matching ratings and rewritten phases[].why. Proposed as one atomic chart group.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer had no cooldowns and described spikes as 'your committal tool' and 'your ultimate'.
audit.why: Hallowed Mist is 22/21/20/19/18, Skip 'n Slash 13/12.5/12/11.5/11 with a partial refund on hit, Needlework 120/100/80; Body Slam 14s and Explosive Cask 100s.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d, breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.mid and tradeGood now carry 22s, 14s and 100s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer said only 'She's safe inside it' about Hallowed Mist, which reads as blanket immunity. It also used male pronouns for Gwen throughout.
audit.why: Riot's W text: she can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist. Body Slam puts you inside the circle, so your Drunken Rage auto and Barrel Roll keep landing — that is the whole reason the level-6 all-in works, and it was stated only in the content layer.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns now state the inside/outside rule; breakdown.mid, breakdown.late and report[8] corrected to female pronouns.

audit.whatIsWrong: tradeBad gave a whiffed Body Slam as '13 seconds' and never named what makes it whiff.
audit.why: Body Slam is 14s at rank 1, and Skip 'n Slash is the dash that steps out of it.
audit.corrected: tradeBad and dontsFull[2].d now name her E dash and the correct 14s.
